title: Premium Holding Fee Settlement on a Homesite Reservation Release
content:
**Settlement clause.** On a buyer release of a Homesite Reservation, the reservation deposit received is refunded in full, one refund per source payment. The premium holding fee received is the total of the payments received on the reservation ledger with the component premium holding fee.

A release is inside the full-refund window when the signed release is received within the class's full-refund window days after the window start, the window start being the later of the reservation date and the day the required funds became complete. Days are counted from the day after the window start, and a release received on the last counted day is inside the window. The day the required funds became complete is the latest posting date of a payment received with the component reservation deposit, or, where the class carries a premium holding fee above zero, the later of that date and the latest posting date of a payment received with the component premium holding fee.

Inside the window the premium holding fee received is refunded in full where the class refunds the premium holding fee on a release inside the window; where it does not, the release is settled as one after the window.

After the window, the premium holding fee release refund is the premium holding fee received less the release forfeit. The release refund percent after the window is the release loyalty percent plus the release lender bonus plus the release grace bonus, never more than one hundred percent; the refundable share is the premium holding fee received times that percent, rounded half up to the cent, and the unadjusted forfeit is the premium holding fee received less the refundable share.

The release loyalty percent is the class's percent of the premium holding fee refunded after the window; the release lender bonus and the release grace bonus are each zero percentage points; and the release forfeit is the unadjusted forfeit. The premium holding fee release refund after the window is therefore the class's after-window percent of the premium holding fee received, rounded half up to the cent, and the rest of the premium holding fee is the release forfeit.

## Worked settlement (hypothetical: premium holding fee received 1500.00, after-window percent 50, full-refund window 5 days)

| Release | Premium holding fee refund | Release forfeit |
|---|---|---|
| inside the window | 1500.00 | none |
| after the window | 50 percent of 1500.00, which is 750.00 | 750.00 |

## Window dates (same hypothetical; reservation dated 1 June, required funds complete 3 June)

The window start is 3 June, the later of the two dates. Day one is 4 June and the last counted day is 8 June: a signed release received on 8 June is inside the window, one received on 9 June is after it.
